myTripsDescription: Start from a blank plan or continue organizing each day from your search results.

meta.toolsDescription: Rename the trip, change its status, or move the dates.
meta.title: Trip details
meta.description: Rename the trip, adjust its dates, or update its status.
meta.modeRangeHint: Existing plans stay on their calendar days; days cut from the range lose their plans.
meta.modeShiftHint: Keeps the trip length and moves every plan with it.
meta.rangeInvalid: The end date cannot be before the start date.
meta.rangeTooLong: A trip can be at most 61 days long.
meta.removedWarning: Shortening removes {days} day(s) and deletes {items} of your own arrangements on them.
meta.removedConfirm: I understand the plans on the removed days will be deleted
meta.flightNotice: Booked flights whose day changes are reset to unset, because a flight number is tied to its calendar date.
meta.routesNotice: Computed travel times are cleared after a date change; recompute them from the day view.
meta.conflictBlocked: This trip changed in another window. Reload it before editing.

noDatesTitle: This trip has no dates yet
noDatesBody: Set the departure and return dates before planning each day. Recreate it from My trips, or add the flights with the tools above first.
cloudLoadFailed: {message} — nothing was switched; please try again shortly.
cloudLoadFallback: Could not load the cloud version
overwriteFailed: {message} — your local edits are kept; try again shortly.
overwriteFallback: Could not overwrite the cloud version
shareNotFound: This share link does not exist or has been revoked.
shareDisclaimer: Timetables, exits and prices can change; reconfirm on the day you travel. Each leg shows its data source and refresh time.

intent.placeholderDay: e.g. rain on this day, move it indoors
intent.placeholderTrip: e.g. less walking across the whole trip
intent.dayRequired: Pick a day first, or switch to the whole trip.
intent.exampleRain: Rain on this day, move it indoors
intent.exampleShopping: More time to shop, one stop fewer
intent.sheetDescription: Nothing is saved until you apply. Locked stops, fixed times, your own additions and meals you chose are all kept.
intent.unchanged: {count} stop(s) stay exactly as they are.
intent.exhaustedTitle: There is nothing else in this area
intent.exhaustedNoAlternatives: Every verified place we have around here is already in your plan, so this request cannot be met without dropping something you have.
intent.exhaustedNoChange: The plan already reads this way, so there is nothing to change. Try naming a specific stop or a different day.
intent.fewerStops: This day ends up with {count} fewer stop(s) and there is no other verified place left to fill it.
intent.alternativesLeft: {count} other verified place(s) in this area were not used.
intent.applied: The change is applied. Travel times for the affected days need recomputing.
intent.partialNote: Part of this plan came from the built-in catalog rather than the AI planner.
